Name: Planned Community Farm
Author: NarraStan
Description:
[b][u][size=4]⍟ Description
[/size][/u][/b][size=2][list]
[*][size=2]Replaces the standard farm for a cozier map that includes dedicated crop fields, beehive + lightning rod areas, farm + wizard buildings, and spouse patios for up to four players. [/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Based on [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url][size=2]'s [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3679]Capitalist Dream Farm[/url][size=2].[/size]
[/list][/size]


[b][size=4][u]⍟ Requirements[/u][/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]


[b][size=4][u]⍟ Installation[/u][/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Unzip, then drag the "[CP] Planned Community Farm" folder into your mods folder. No config file necessary.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]The farmhand cabins will auto-populate on the "nearby" option.[/size]
[/list]


[b][u][size=4]⍟ Recommended Mods[/size][/u]
[/b][size=2]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]Aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6630]Custom Spouse Patio[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7775]Custom Spouse Patio Wizard[/url][/size]
[/list][/size]Will allow you to easily place and move the farmhands' spouse patios outside.

[size=2][list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor[/url][/size]
[/list][/size]A spot for a tractor garage is included on this map.



[b][u][size=4]⍟ Credits[/size][/u]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]DaisyNiko's original Capitalist Dream Farm and edited pet bowl texture.[/size]
[/list]
